> I read this as an explicit fix and test migration request - inspect the code, verify the RED failures, implement GUI-to-daemon workspace synchronization in `src-tauri/src/ipc/project.rs`, migrate `src-tauri/tests/ipc_hardening_contract.rs` and `src-tauri/src/ipc/tests.rs` to use daemon-backed registration/terminal IPC, and verify GREEN.

### Verification Evidence (RED to GREEN)

#### 1. Initial RED Failures

     --> tests/ipc_hardening_contract.rs:82:9

   80 |     let spawned = cmd_terminal_spawn(

#### 2. Changes Made
- `src-tauri/src/ipc/project.rs`: Kept GUI project registration synchronized with daemon workspace registration (`client.register_workspace`).
- `src-tauri/src/ipc/tests.rs`: Updated terminal unit tests (`tauri_mock_terminal_events_use_registered_workspace`, attach, lifecycle, cwd, burst) to register the workspace with the daemon server before terminal spawn.
- `src-tauri/tests/ipc_hardening_contract.rs`: Updated the integration harness to initialize a test `DaemonServer` / `DaemonClient`, register the workspace on both GUI and daemon registries, pass `Arc<DaemonClient>` into terminal IPC commands, and inspect PTY state via `daemon_server.terminal_service().pty_manager()` without weakening assertions.
